message: Applied the machine-specific cmd.exe launcher policy, initialized the run, followed Start_Here through the execution cut-off, resolved an Idle queued-task state, and treated the direct documentation inventory request as the active work.
Added a documentation inventory command and scanner, generated short and per-file reports, and integrated documentation as the explicit third section of the master source-text report.

Scanned all 880 files under docs: 816 text files and 64 binary files, 258101 raw words, 4516628 total bytes, 2212696 text bytes, 2303932 binary bytes, and 2210361 text characters. Exact-content deduplication identified 204 duplicate text files and reduced the word count to 214872.

Documentation has a 37576137-character upper bound across 17 non-English locales; the aggregate logging, comments, and documentation ceiling is 39061359 characters. Exact-file deduplication reduces the documentation-only ceiling to 30124459 characters.

Node syntax checks and scanner self-tests passed. Independent assertions reconciled 880 on-disk files with 880 detailed rows, all word/byte/format totals, text and binary totals, localization formulas, package command, master section order, combined totals, and report links. SHA-256 hashes were stable after regeneration, and markdownlint-cli2 reported zero issues across seven reports.

Startup role filenames were first attempted without their .role suffix and the spaced global-standard path was not quoted successfully; directory evidence and the GLOBAL~1.MD short path resolved both reads. Two PowerShell validation-display commands had an empty-pipeline parser error; corrected commands completed without changing files before their intended regeneration steps.
